GET /v1/products/search route: catalog search controller over the merged B1-05d use case; app.module builds the governed union upstream once per process, the link registrar, the demo rebate quoter (refused at startup in prod or with any live endpoint) and Redis search session and cursor storage; searchProducts no longer planned, route schemas regenerated. 50304 carries its cause and alert details; refill failures and material fallback rejections degrade with alerts; same-cursor retry keeps delivered pages; links registered only for cards actually delivered; every store keyed by app_id. Downgraded by the orchestrator (approvals 18): the session lock is per process, so with several API instances a late page retry can overwrite a newer seen set (a delivered product may show again on a later page); production starts with one app instance (owner decision 2026-10-07), no change to amounts or attribution; cross-process locking before scaling out (followups). Written by hand.
